notes: The 'whose' of 'whose branches' fuses the recast lamed with the possessive suffix, headed on the preposition since no relative stands (rules 22, 30); the competing reading — 'whose' to the suffix alone with the lamed unrepresented under rules 40 and 52 — is named in that unit's note, which is what rule 8 requires.
Both resultative lameds after הָיָה are unrepresented once the verb carries 'became'/'be' (rules 21, 40).
